name: mrpc/xscraper
description: Read x.com posts and their replies from PHP without the official API. Request-frugal: incremental refresh, smart caching, single-flight locking and a shared throttle.

suggest.mrpc/pramnosframework: Default HTTP transport (Pramnos\Http\Client) and a PSR-16 cache to share with your application
suggest.psr/http-client: Use any PSR-18 HTTP client through Psr18Transport
suggest.psr/http-factory: Required together with psr/http-client for Psr18Transport
